title: Agent observation quality and budget: post-action settle, frame-aware AX snapshot with warnings, set-of-marks screenshots, capped projection and image budget
summary: After each action wait for commit, first paint and a short AX/DOM quiet window with a cap (Codex) plus request tracking and ambient page-event notes (Aside); make the AX snapshot frame-aware with per-frame warnings and deadlines; produce set-of-marks screenshots from the existing ScreenshotAnnotated artifact kind as a visual fallback; cap the page projection by characters and elements; and give the model-facing image path detail levels and a per-run image budget.
whyItMatters: The UI caps sessions at 12 steps and the AI loop at 5 (SRC), so every wasted observation is expensive. Settle and snapshot quality are table-stakes in both browser references; Verevon's native-AX refs are already stronger, so this is about reliability and cost, not a rewrite.

referenceBestPractice.mechanism: Settle: after an action, if a navigation started await Page.frameNavigated/lifecycle commit (poll 10 ms, cap 5 s), then first paint (cap 5 s), then subscribe to Accessibility/DOM mutation events and resolve when none arrive for 50-100 ms or 750 ms elapsed; report the settle time and optionally keep a p90 per host as a prior. Snapshot: Page.getFrameTree + DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot + Accessibility.getFullAXTree per frame session over auto-attached flat sessions, each with a per-frame timeout inside a global deadline; stitch child trees under their IFRAME owner node; collect {frameId, error} into warnings[]. || Merged items add: After act: wait for DOMContentLoaded (<=2 s), sample MutationObserver counts every 100 ms until a 350 ms window has <=1% mutation ratio twice; track same-site in-flight requests up to 1.2 s; extra dwell on SPA URL changes; queue framenavigated/dialog/popup/download events into the next observation. Marks: Page.captureScreenshot, overlay a box and label per interactive ref (from AX box model), return PNG plus legend; prompt rule to return to snapshots after a visual action. || A page-side function walks the DOM and keeps visible, in-viewport interactive elements (a, button, input, select, textarea, summary, details, option, interactive ARIA roles), emits tag plus allowlisted attributes (aria-*, name, placeholder, href, role, value) and short text, recurses into child frames, and stops at 200 elements or 20k chars; a second view lists frames with owner-element attributes. Images carry a detail hint; a preparation step downsizes to the target long edge for the detail level, appends a resize notice, and drops or downgrades older images when a per-conversation budget is reached.

verevonToday.gap: No agent-action settle (agents rely on explicit wait/wait_for); no per-frame deadline or warning list was found around the CDP fetch of the AX tree (verify the capture call site near the native_projection_from_cdp caller); truncation is by order, not viewport priority. The Verevon UI cannot show or use AX refs. || Explicit wait_for actions and fixed waits exist, plus a typed event SSE for the UI, but no adaptive settle was found and page events are not shown to reach the model's next observation. ScreenshotAnnotated exists only as an enum/parse entry plus tests (grep in this audit finds no producer), so set-of-marks is absent; coordinate actions and screenshots are shipped. || Quarry already emits a CDP accessibility projection with frame topology and @eN refs (the stronger primitive, used by Model Plane browser.act), but no character budget or alternative visible-DOM view was found, and the Verevon UI's BrowserObservation type has no field for AX refs or frames. For images: the Model Plane execution-core browser observation carries only a screenshot_ref (an artifact id string), the only image limits found are a 20 MiB cap on the image-generation route, and grep over apps/Model Plane (Rust and Go) finds no image budget, downscale or detail hint. Whether browser screenshots are ever sent to the model as pixels was not established.

approach: Ingestion Plane quarry-browser (settle, snapshot, set-of-marks); Model Plane (image budget and cost accounting); Frontend frame view. || Source detail: [R-t2-03-07] Ingestion Plane, quarry-browser/chromiumoxide.rs: add settle() after navigate/click/type/press with per-action budgets (navigation vs click vs type) and emit settle_ms in BrowserTelemetry; for snapshots fetch AX per frame target with timeouts inside a global deadline, return warnings[] in the observation contract (quarry-core BrowserObservation), and reorder truncation by viewport proximity. Frontend Plane: surface refs and warnings in BrowserChrome for co-browsing. Keep truncation explicit so token cost stays visible. || [R-t2-09-11] Ingestion Plane quarry-browser: settle stage after act with same-site request filtering and caps for long-polling pages; extend the observation contract with a bounded events list rendered by the Model Plane into the tool result. Add a mark renderer fed by native AX boxes (no page injection), keep marks tied to the observation revision, and make the PNG ephemeral under ZDR. || [R-t2-02-10] Ingestion Plane observation.rs: add a character budget (and truncation marker) to the AX projection, with an optional visible-DOM projection behind a flag; Frontend Plane: extend BrowserObservation in browser-client.ts with snapshot refs and frames (coordinate with the browser-automation category, which owns the UI action vocabulary). Model Plane (session-core or inference-core): first confirm how screenshots enter model context; only if pixels are sent, add a detail hint on image parts, resize before the provider call, and a per-session image budget that evicts the oldest screenshots, accounted through the cost plane.
dependencies: UI action vocabulary migration to AX refs
Model Plane cost accounting for the image part
risks: Long-polling pages never quiesce, so caps are essential; larger snapshots cost tokens; adding a field to the observation contract needs the Model Plane client to tolerate it. || Long-polling pages (websockets, analytics beacons) need same-site filtering and caps; marks must map to refs from the same observation revision; screenshots under ZDR stay ephemeral. || Two projections to maintain; attribute text from pages reaches the model (injection surface, keep the allowlist); low-detail images misread small text.

verevon.exactGap: Quarry already returns a bounded AX and frame projection on every observation (300 AX nodes with a truncated flag, 64 frames, 50 snapshot targets, a 500-char text snippet), console and network summaries, an observation delta, challenge classification and telemetry (usable_observation_latency_ms, estimated_snapshot_tokens), has an explicit frame-ref action contract, and has a scrape-only hydration settle (3.5 s budget, 300 ms poll) in browser_driver.rs; what is missing is any settle after agent actions (observation.rs captures page state, DevTools events, HTML and the AX projection immediately), per-frame deadlines and a warnings field (one root-frame GetFullAxTree call at depth 8), and viewport-priority truncation. On the Model Plane side observation_from_wire forwards only url, title, text snippet, screenshot id and snapshot targets (console/network summaries are dropped), the planner prompt shows at most 40 targets, no screenshot pixels reach the planner (it is text-only; only the UI suggest-action route sends a screenshot to a separate AnalyzeImage summarizer, capped at 6 MiB with 16k/8k-char prompt budgets), and ScreenshotAnnotated is already produced by the vision sidecar as a red changed-region overlay, not as set-of-marks.

verevon.constraints: Model proposes / Quarry executes: settle, snapshot and truncation are executor concerns and stay in Quarry; the wire change must be additive with serde defaults because execution-core parses WireObservation separately. CDP node handles must stay private (BrowserNativeProjection never serializes backend ids). ZDR: screenshots, annotated PNGs and the visual processor run only when ZDR is off, so any set-of-marks artifact must follow put_artifact_if_allowed and stay ephemeral. The UI still acts through CSS selectors, so AX refs and warnings reach the Model Plane first and the co-browsing UI only after a UI action-vocabulary change.
verevon.approachAdjustment: Narrow to what is missing and has a consumer: (1) agent-action settle with per-action budgets, same-site request filtering and a hard cap, reported as settle_ms, living in observation.rs/driver (not copied from the scrape-only loop in the adapter); (2) add warnings[] to AccessibilityProjection and fetch per-frame AX only if cross-origin iframe coverage is needed (getFullAXTree without frameId defaults to the root frame per CDP docs, INF) under a global deadline; (3) prioritise truncation by viewport and interactivity and align the 50-target Quarry cap with the planner's 40-target view; (4) carry console/network summaries through observation_from_wire if the model should see page events. Defer set-of-marks until the planner actually receives images and give it a new artifact kind (ScreenshotAnnotated already means changed-region overlay); drop the model image detail/budget sub-item until screenshots become model input. Side bug: observation.rs:2140 slices a byte index (&trimmed[..500]) and can panic on a multi-byte boundary.
verevon.effortNote: Settle + warnings + prioritised truncation is M; set-of-marks (M) and image budget have no consumer yet and should be split out or dropped.
verevon.verdictReason: Several claimed gaps are partly built (bounded projection, frame refs, console/network summaries, char budgets on the suggest path, an annotated artifact kind), the image budget has no consumer, and the real gaps are the missing settle, per-frame warnings and Model Plane forwarding.
